lede: The meeting to watch this week is HARC on Tuesday the 21st, where the Town of Telluride's own Shandoka Lot Redevelopment at 860 Black Bear Rd comes back for public hearings on all four buildings — a large-scale new construction project in an Accommodations 2 zone that's been working through the process since August. Beyond that, the week has some genuine texture: the San Miguel Watershed Forum on Tuesday tackles how to actually fund water projects, and Freeski Film Night at the Sheridan on Wednesday is a reliable sign that winter is closer than it feels.

notable.stake: Public hearings on all four buildings of the Town's Shandoka Lot redevelopment.
